caption:
Busy season tends to land in Mr Turtle's neck and shoulders first.

Long hours, deadlines and less sleep often mean more clenching, shallow breathing and hours without moving.

Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier and give your mind a break. It works well as a support alongside sleep, movement and a manageable workload, not instead of them.

Hybi's tip: book your session at the start of a busy stretch, not the end. Add a ten-minute lunch walk and a few slow breaths between meetings.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio work on the tension that builds up in demanding weeks. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
